notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and ensure full lifecycle coverage (schema/contract, core logic, integration).

stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement token schema including fields for token_id, hashed_token, created_at, expires_at, rotated_from_token_id, revoked_flag, and revoked_at. Ensure persistence layer supports indexed lookup by token and expiration.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No persistent lifecycle-aware token schema currently defined

stories.title: Token Expiration and Rotation Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to enforce token expiration validation and support secure rotation flow (invalidate old token, issue new token, maintain rotation lineage). Ensure expired tokens are automatically rejected.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No expiration or rotation logic currently implemented

stories.title: Authentication Middleware Integration for Lifecycle Enforcement
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle checks (expiration, revocation, rotation status) into existing bearer token validation middleware used by GPTReader and related services, ensuring consistent enforcement across all entry points.
